title: Horizon-matched normal-period comparison for multi-mission masking (pre-specification, written before any computation)
reason: Reviewer-risk check: the frozen normal-period comparison measures outcomes 1-2 years after its baseline (FY2016/17 -> FY2017/18-2018/19) while late recovery measures 4-6 years after (FY2018/19 -> FY2022/23-2024/25). Masking may grow with horizon alone. This check equalises the horizon.
missions_note: UK loan venues excluded: DCMS Note 19 states pre-2016/17 loan-venue figures are not comparable.

primary.cohort_rule: Museum groups with numeric positive baselines and numeric outcomes for all four missions in both windows; Museum of the Home excluded (DCMS comparator convention); groups with documented baseline-year definition differences excluded: Horniman and National Portrait Gallery (Note 15, formal education under-16 in 2012/13-2013/14) and Sir John Soane's Museum (Note 17, 2012/13).
primary.metric: capped attainment a=min(Y/B,1); equal-weight E=mean_k a; masking M=E-min_k a; summarise mean and median over museum-years; set-valued state at tau=0.90 with epsilon=0 (GREEN if min>=tau, RED if max<tau, else AMBER)

decision_rule.R: mean M (late, 4-6y) / mean M (normal, 4-6y), same cohort
decision_rule.R >= 1.5: retain the claim that late-recovery divergence exceeds normal drift; replace 'nearly double' with the horizon-matched figures
decision_rule.1.0 < R < 1.5: soften: late-recovery masking is larger, but part of the original contrast reflects horizon
decision_rule.R <= 1.0: drop the 'nearly double' claim; report that the contrast is explained by horizon

sensitivity.S1: baseline FY2013/14 -> outcomes FY2017/18-2018/19 (4-5y) vs baseline FY2018/19 -> FY2022/23-2023/24 (4-5y); exclude Horniman and NPG
sensitivity.S2: primary windows but retaining Horniman, NPG and Soane (definition-flagged)
sensitivity.S3: short-horizon reference: four-mission version of the frozen normal check (FY2016/17 -> FY2017/18-2018/19) on the primary cohort

reporting: All results reported regardless of direction; descriptive only, no significance tests; per-museum direction counts reported.
